hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in */frontend/*|*/backend/*) printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"🛠  Dev build to see this change: live servers — (cd frontend && npm run dev) + (cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000); or Docker — docker compose up --build -d, then hard-refresh (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R).","suppressOutput":true}';; esac

b=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$b" = "main" ]; then printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"🚀 Commit landed on main — deploy: git pull origin main && docker compose up --build -d  |  verify: docker compose ps && curl -f http://localhost:18082/api/health"}'; else r=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#(\.git)?/?$##; s#^.*[/:]([^/]+/[^/]+)$#\1#'); printf '{"systemMessage":"🔀 Committed to %s — open PR for this branch: https://github.com/%s/pulls?q=is%%3Apr+head%%3A%s"}' "$b" "$r" "$b"; fi
